and I are ICE HSI special agents assigned to our office's Document
and (Immigration) Benefit Fraud Task Force (DBFTF).
When we read in the Post two weeks ago that Epstein had arranged a marriage
between a United States Citizen and an Eastern European woman to keep that
woman in the U.S., we realized that there is a foreign component to Epstein's
trafficking enterprise with which HSI can assist.
HSI has access to Department of Homeland Security databases that we use in the
normal course of business that store information regarding the following aspects
of immigration:
•

Alien Files (individuals who have applied for Green Cards and for
Naturalization, or whom have appeared in immigration legal proceedings)

•

Immigrant Visas (individuals who have received a Green Card overseas)

•

Non-Immigrant Visas (individuals who have received or applied for
temporary visas to visit or study in the U.S.)

•

International border crossings (for both foreigners and U.S. Citizens)

•

Treasury Enforcement Communication System (TECS) (a database that
contains records of people of interest to the law enforcement community,
and where wants and warrant information is entered)

HSI's DBFTF conducts marriage fraud investigations. Our most prominent current
investigation involves an arranged marriage related to the heavily-covered NXIVM
sex cult trial at EDNY this past spring.
and I are the co-case agents of that
ongoing marriage fraud investigation and have been members of the NXIVM
prosecution team for over one year.
If your task force needs any assistance in this limited area involving foreign-born
subjects of your investigation, then we would be pleased to assist.
